# 🏗️ WP-19 design record — beams, columns and curtain-wall depth (`w2-wp19-frame`)

Binding for every agent working on this package. `T` = ticket folder, `S` = `✏️s/🔌️plugins/🏙️bim/🗿️artifacts/🏢️model/🏅️standards/🔖️1/🪆️subsets/✳️any`.
Sources: `r9-audit-completeness.md` §5 WP-19, `r9-decisions.md` §2 (keyed panel overrides), `r12-wave-brief.md`, `r11-finish-brief.md` (all hard rules).

## 1. Schema (done, generated by `bun T/r3-f1-gen-model.ts` from `T/r12-w2-wp19-frame-model.ts` + the three edited rows in `T/r3-f1-gen-model.ts`)

```rust
pub struct Beam { storey, beam_type, axis: Axis, top_offset: f64, end_top_offset: Option<f64>, phase, name }   // start/end are GONE
pub struct Column { storey, column_type, position: Point2, rotation: f64, tilt: Option<Slope>, base_offset, top, phase, name }
pub struct CurtainWall { storey, curtain_wall_type: String, axis: Axis, base_offset, top, u_grid: Option<CurtainGrid>, v_grid: Option<CurtainGrid>, phase, name }
        // u_spacing, v_spacing, mullion, panel_material, mullion_material are GONE (they live in the type)
pub struct CurtainWallType { name, u_grid: CurtainGrid, v_grid: CurtainGrid, interior_mullion: Profile, border_mullion: Profile, panel: CurtainPanel, panel_material: String, mullion_material: String }
pub struct CurtainPanelOverride { curtain: String, u: u32, v: u32, panel: CurtainPanel }     // collection curtain_panel_overrides, (curtain,u,v) unique
pub enum CurtainGrid { Spacing { spacing: f64 }, Lines { positions: Vec<f64> } }
pub enum CurtainPanel { Glass, Solid { material: String }, Door { door_type: String }, Window { window_type: String }, Empty }
```
Snapshot collections: `curtain_wall_types: BTreeMap<String, CurtainWallType>`, `curtain_panel_overrides: BTreeMap<String, CurtainPanelOverride>` (both `skip_serializing_if empty`).
Patches: `BeamPatch.axis`, `BeamPatch.end_top_offset: Option<Assigned<Option<f64>>>`, `ColumnPatch.tilt: Option<Assigned<Option<Slope>>>`, `CurtainWallPatch.{curtain_wall_type, u_grid, v_grid}` (`u_grid`/`v_grid` are `Option<Assigned<Option<CurtainGrid>>>`), `CurtainWallTypePatch`, `CurtainPanelOverridePatch`.
`Placement::Beam { axis: Axis }`, `Placement::Column { position, rotation, tilt }` (modify kernel updated). All fixtures and assets were migrated by `T/r12-w2-wp19-migrate.ts` (every existing curtain wall references a type `cwt-N`).

### Semantics
* **Beam axis** = `Axis::Line | Axis::Arc` exactly like a wall; the top is at `storey_top + top_offset` at the start and `storey_top + end_top_offset.unwrap_or(top_offset)` at the end, linear in arc length (inclined beam). The profile hangs below the top line (existing `section_of`).
* **Column tilt** `Some(Slope { direction, angle })`: the axis leans from the base point towards `direction` by `angle` from the vertical; the cross-section perpendicular to the axis is the type profile (rotated by `rotation` first, about the vertical, then tilted); both ends are cut by HORIZONTAL planes (base_z, top_z). Closed form: with lean unit vector `u = (cos direction, sin direction)` the horizontal section is the profile (already rotated by `rotation`) stretched by `1/cos(angle)` along `u`, and the top section is the bottom section shifted by `rise * tan(angle) * u`; the solid is the sheared prism between them. Volume = `A_profile * rise / cos(angle)`; `position` is the axis point at the base elevation. Valid tilt: `0 < angle <= pi/3` (60 degrees), `direction` finite.
* **Grid rule** (type `u_grid`/`v_grid`, optionally overridden per wall by `CurtainWall.u_grid`/`v_grid`): `Spacing{s}`: `n = max(1, ceil(extent/s - 1e-9))` equal cells (existing behaviour), `Lines{positions}`: the interior lines, metres from the start of the axis (u, arc length for arcs) / above the base (v); positions outside `(eps, extent-eps)` and duplicates are ignored by the layout and reported by a diagnostic; cells are the intervals between `0`, the valid sorted lines and `extent`. Cell indices `u in 0..u_cells`, `v in 0..v_cells` (v = 0 is the base row).
* **Panels**: effective panel of a cell = the override `(curtain, u, v)` if one exists, else `CurtainWallType.panel`. `Glass` = thin pane (existing `PANEL_THICKNESS`) of `panel_material`; `Solid{material}` = opaque panel (thickness = min(mullion depth, 0.06)) of that material; `Empty` = nothing; `Door{door_type}` / `Window{window_type}` = a frame (the type's `frame_width`/`frame_depth`) plus leaf (door: one leaf, two for `DoorLeaves::Double`, thickness 0.04) or glass panes (window: `panes` equal panes, 0.024) filling the cell opening; materials from the types. A door belongs in row 0 (diagnostic otherwise).
* **Mullions**: vertical members on every u edge, horizontal members on every v edge spanning between verticals (existing construction), the OUTER edges (u=0, u=length, v=0, v=height) use `border_mullion`, interior edges `interior_mullion`. Members are placed with the existing `member()` clamp so they stay inside the extent.
* **Hosted openings cut panels** (r9 row 12): an opening hosted by a curtain wall (window/door/void) removes its rectangle (host coordinates u x z from `opening-frames`) from the panels it overlaps; the panel is rebuilt from the rectangles that remain (rectangle subtraction), mullions are untouched.
* **Overrides** are individually addressable records (r9-decisions §2). Out-of-grid overrides (u >= u_cells or v >= v_cells) are diagnosed and ignored by the solids.

## 2. Mutations (binary tags 19000..19099; payloads are final)

New kinds: `set-beam-axis`(19000) `{id, axis}`; `set-column-tilt`(19001) `{id, tilt: Option<Slope>}` (absent = plumb); `create-curtain-wall-type`(19002) `{id, curtain_wall_type}`; `set-curtain-wall-type`(19003) sparse `{id, name?, u_grid?, v_grid?, interior_mullion?, border_mullion?, panel?, panel_material?, mullion_material?}`; `delete-curtain-wall-type`(19004) `{id}` (refuses while used); `set-curtain-wall-type-of`(19005) `{id, curtain_wall_type}`; `set-curtain-wall-grid`(19006) `{id, u_grid: Option<Assigned<Option<CurtainGrid>>>, v_grid: same}` (assigned null clears the override); `create-curtain-panel-override`(19007) `{id, curtain_panel_override}`; `set-curtain-panel-override`(19008) `{id, panel}`; `delete-curtain-panel-override`(19009) `{id}`.
Changed kinds: `set-beam` `{id, beam_type?, top_offset?, end_top_offset: Option<Assigned<Option<f64>>>, name?}`; `set-curtain-wall` `{id, axis?, base_offset?, top?, name?}`; `create-beam`, `create-curtain-wall`, `split-beam` (splits a line or an arc), `delete-curtain-wall` (cascades its overrides), `create-column`, copy/mirror/array/place/align kernels, `delete-material`/`delete-door-type`/`delete-window-type` (refuse while a curtain wall type or override uses them).
Rust module/variant names follow the kebab names (`set_beam_axis::SetBeamAxis`, `ModelMutation::SetBeamAxis`, `create_curtain_panel_override::CreateCurtainPanelOverride`, field `curtain_panel_override`, …).

## 3. Inference (owner: the inference agent)
`🪞️curtain-layout`: `CurtainLayout` gains the resolved grid (`u_edges`, `v_edges`, the default panel, in-grid overrides, stray override ids) from the wall, its type and its overrides (dependency honest: wall + type + the overrides of the wall); `🧊️element-solids`: arc/inclined beam sweeps (`sweep_profile` with a z-ramp, add a framework function with tests in `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/📐️geometry/🕸️mesh`), beam-column joins (a beam end that lies inside a column footprint of its storey is trimmed to the column face along the beam axis; derived, never stored; the beam solid depends on the columns of its storey), tilted column solids, curtain wall solids (mullions border/interior, panels by kind, door/window panels, cut by hosted openings); `🧮️quantities`: panel counts and areas by kind, mullion lengths (interior/border), beam length along the arc and trimmed length, tilted column volume; `⚠️diagnostics` (en+de): `curtain-wall.override-out-of-grid`, `curtain-wall.door-not-at-base`, `curtain-wall.grid-line-outside`, `curtain-wall.duplicate-override` (two overrides address one cell), `reference.curtain-wall-type`, `reference.curtain-panel` (door/window type, material of a panel), `reference.curtain-override-host`, `column.tilt-invalid`; plan linework / bodies / clashes / schedules / annotation anchors read `Beam.axis` and the tilt. Model graph: new nodes only where needed; gating + cache-transparency tests.

## 4. Editor (owner: the editor agent)
Entity fields: beam (axis kind, start, end, bulge, end offset), column (tilt direction/angle), curtain wall (type, grid overrides), curtain wall type entity (collection `curtain_wall_types`, outliner group, create/rename/delete, fields), curtain panel override entity (properties: curtain, u, v, panel kind + type/material). Tools: arc beam gesture (like the arc wall), tilt field + handle, grid-intersection column command (emits ordinary `create-column` mutations), curtain grid editing (add/remove grid line by click in the world/elevation view → `set-curtain-wall-grid`), panel override by click in the world window and in properties (→ create/set/delete override). en first, de second, accessible, hotkeys, library entries, undo = inverse mutations.

## 5. IO (owner: the io agent)
IFC export/import: `IfcBeam` with `Axis` representation as `IfcPolyline` (straight, 3D when inclined) or `IfcTrimmedCurve` of an `IfcCircle` (arc) and the swept body; `IfcColumn` tilted via a sheared extrusion; curtain walls as `IfcCurtainWall` aggregating `IfcPlate` (panels, CURTAIN_PANEL) and `IfcMember` (mullions) with door/window panels as `IfcDoor`/`IfcWindow`; authored parameters carried in `Semio_Authoring` for lossless import (follow the existing exporter/importer pattern); sqlite snapshot cells, glTF/SVG via solids, text and binary codecs; ifcopenshell oracle.

## 6. Verification
Third-party oracles: three.js mesh volumes (beam, column, curtain), ifcopenshell (IFC), shapely (plan); `.feature` scenarios; examples (office: arc beam, tilted column, curtain wall with door panel + overrides, built through `T/r4-x-examples-gen.ts`).
